verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design boldly with a 4-line headline that fills the square, but the bottom row is badly handled: the subcopy is a centred, ragged 3-line block whose left edge (~98px) doesn't line up with the headline (~125px), and it sits side by side with the CTA crammed under the headline, so neither shares an axis with the centred type above. B keeps the original's centred stack intact and on brand, but it is basically a scaled copy: the headline runs almost edge to edge with only about 50px side margins, the subcopy leaves an orphaned 'flavours.' on its own line, and the block sits low, with about 225px of dead orange above versus about 150px below. B is the cleaner and more faithful of the two.
